facts.value: Nutritional psychiatry is the emerging scientific field dedicated to exploring the relationship between the effects of diet and mental health.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Science in Health Sciences – Healthy Lifestyles and Fitness Science

facts.value: There is ongoing research about how poor diets directly influence the development of cognitive decline, as well as symptoms of psychiatric conditions, such as ADHD, depression, inflammation, anxiety, bipolar disorder, and schizophrenia.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Science in Health Sciences – Healthy Lifestyles and Fitness Science

facts.value: There is also research about how specific diets, those that focus on maintaining balanced nutrition, could be potential avenues for treatment of mental health conditions.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Science in Health Sciences – Healthy Lifestyles and Fitness Science

facts.value: A healthy diet provides the necessary micro and macronutrients that serve as the building blocks for curating stable mental health.
